xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
The Company mainly operates in the business of manufacturing of Engines wherein two customer based reportable segments had been identified namely - Business to Business B2B and Business to Customer B2C upto 10th October 2025. However, post transfer of net assets of B2C business segment, the Company operates in a segment of B2B only at standalone level. Further as per para 4 of Ind AS 108 Operating Segments the Company is required to disclose segment information only in the Consolidated Financial Results. Accordingly disclosure of this information has been included under Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and year ended 31st March 2026.

Explanatory notes related to XBRL :

In the General Info section, for the field Segment Reporting we have selected "Single Segment" though we have Multi Segments i.e B2B and B2C till 10th October 2025. However, post transfer of net assets of B2C business segment, the Company operates in a segment of B2B only at standalone level. When we are selecting Multi Segment in General Info Section, it is mandatory to fill in the Segment Reporting tab or else there is validation error. However as per para 4 of Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”, the Company is required to disclose segment information only in the Consolidated Financial Results. Accordingly, disclosure of this information has been included under Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and year ended 31 March 2026. To keep the XBRL aligned with published standalone results and avoid the validation error, we have reported the Single segment in Info Section and reported the Consolidated segment in Consolidated XBRL Results file.
